views.name: venue_booking_intervals
views.definition:
SELECT b.id,
    b.event_request_id,
    b.venue_id,
    b.requested_by,
    b.status,
    b.starts_at,
    b.ends_at,
    b.layout,
    b.notes,
    b.decided_by,
    b.decided_at,
    b.decision_reason,
    b.created_at,
    b.updated_at,
    b.replaces_booking_id,
    b.reserved_setup_minutes,
    b.reserved_turnaround_minutes,
    b.hold_expires_at,
    b.held_by,
    b.held_at,
    b.expired_at,
    b.cancelled_by,
    b.cancelled_at,
    b.cancellation_reason,
    venue_occupied_start(b.starts_at,
        CASE
            WHEN ((b.ends_at > now()) AND (e.status <> 'COMPLETED'::text)) THEN v.setup_minutes
            ELSE b.reserved_setup_minutes
        END) AS occupied_starts_at,
    venue_occupied_end(b.ends_at,
        CASE
            WHEN ((b.ends_at > now()) AND (e.status <> 'COMPLETED'::text)) THEN v.turnaround_minutes
            ELSE b.reserved_turnaround_minutes
        END) AS occupied_ends_at
   FROM ((venue_bookings b
     JOIN venues v ON ((v.id = b.venue_id)))
     JOIN event_requests e ON ((e.id = b.event_request_id)));
